title.narrative: Area Based Response: urgent support for WASH and SNFI needs in the open area refugee settlement in Khartoum

description.narrative: ltpgtThe requested modification of the project aims to contribute to the WASH and S/NFI sectors objectives through the provision of life-saving NFI assistance and Emergency WASH services to the most vulnerable population affected by crisis in Khartoum State, specifically in Karrari locality, Omdurman, targeting 12,023 beneficiaries, (Male 5,891 female 5,988) through provision of life-saving NFI kits, implementation of a waste management system, hygiene awareness campaign, provision of clean water, sanitation facilities, and distribution of hygiene kits.ltbrgtThis project is designed based on consultation with the local authorities and on the base of the results obtained through the Needs Assessment implemented by COOPI and UPO in Karrari locality, Omdurman, Khartoum State.ltbrgtThe project will continue engaging all the local stakeholders including youth, women and community service committees on the planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluations. The project will ensure that the IDPs representatives are also involved in the different stages of the project including the exit strategy.ltbrgtThe project will target the IDPs, refugees and host communities currently living in Karrari locality that have limited access to NFI and WASH facilities and at risk of cholera and other diarrhea diseases. 1130 lifesaving NFI kits will be procured and distributed. Water supply, hygiene and sanitation services will be improved both at community and public facilities, in particular this result will be achieved throughout:ltbrgt-The establishment of a Solid Waste Management System (ToTs to implement waste collection campaigns, waste disposal, creation of Waste Management Committees).ltbrgt-The Promotion of good hygiene practices to prevent water-borne diseases ltbrgt-provision of basic hygiene kits together with specific risk messaging towards Cholera emergency response. ltbrgt-COOPI will provide water for 10000 beneficiaries in the gathering sites to ensure that they have a regular water supply for their daily useltbrgt-The rehabilitation and desludging of 8 latrines compounds will be implemented.ltbrgtThis project will be interlinked with the intervention proposed by UNHCR (CBPF-SUD-23-R-UN-26862), which will allow to respond to the NFI needs of the targeted population by providing general NFI kits (UNHCR will procure the kits and COOPI will distribute them). In addition, COOPI will collaborate with the local national partner United Peace Organization (UPO), whose support and knowhow will increase the sustainability of the project and community engagement and ownership and further guarantee the acceptance necessary to implement the activities.ltbrgtlt/pgt
